items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1973-09-07
items.q: And one of the Mareros, he's a Simon, he's a brother.

ctx.x: But anyway, so you started taking lessons when you were about 18 years old. And then when did you start playing music?

Well then, I'll tell you what happened. I've forgotten about this. I returned in the Orleans in 1921. That's when I met Chester's artists. They were advertising. And I rode on the truck. While I'm still in the preliminary stages. So. You hadn't played any jobs yet. Well I played some with a little band, with Bernie Young, Al Simeon, Omar Simeon, Jimmy McHenry, and people like that, you know. And we were non-union. Just 15? Yeah, we were non-union then. Well we could read a little. You see, yeah, we was reading a…
